content.title: BJP to stage protest against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA
content.caption: The BJP will hold a demonstration in Kallakurichi on November 18 against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh.

slides.heading: BJP to stage protest against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA
slides.text: The BJP will hold a demonstration in Kallakurichi on November 18 against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh.

slides.heading: Protest against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA
slides.text: The BJP will stage a protest against TVK’s Kallakurichi MLA Arul Vignesh, who allegedly sent inappropriate messages to the Collector.

slides.heading: BJP demands accountability
slides.text: The BJP demands accountability from the ruling government and a special court to ensure an effective investigation into the allegations.
